author: fester
body: The result-dest override that steers the let VALUE into the local's register is scoped to the value and restored before the BODY is emitted. It leaked into the body until 2026-07-23, so every dest-honoring emitter in the body wrote the live local: in `text-index-of`, the five-argument marshal into `str-index-loop` evaluated the literal `0` and `slen - sublen + 1` straight into the register still holding `sublen`, and the call went out with limit 12 and sublen 12 on an 11-character string -- every `text-contains` on this lane answered False through it. Found by disassembly of the reduced probe; only FRAMED functions were affected, because the frameless arm never sets a dest.
